⚠️Traffic Advisory⚠️ 

6th St is closed between Wall and San Pedro due to a Police Investigation.  

Anyone with information regarding the incident in the area is asked to call Central Division.   You can stay anonymous.   

Please use 7th St or 8th St as an alternative.

data.raw_text:
📣 Traffic Advisory: Gander RCMP is currently responding to a tractor trailer blocking the westbound lane of the Trans-Canada Highway east of Gander, in the area of Square Pond Hill. One lane of traffic is passable but road conditions are hazardous, quickly deteriorating and visibility is low. 

⚠️ While the TCH is passable, motorists should expect delays and are asked to drive with extreme caution and patience. 

Please consider delaying any immediate travel. If you must travel, please exercise caution and patience and drive according to road and weather conditions. 

Remember — snow means slow! ❄️
